hypothesis: Historical Mode B is the live Manny/SMPL body state from one fixed tick earlier than Mode A, and startup velocity publication timing distinguishes the states.

supporting_evidence_before_experiment.e7_source_localization: Only the live root/body sample changed; PoseSearch identity/time, mimic reference frames, future poses, raw terrain heights, and previous actions remained exact.

competing_explanations: Velocity publication ownership, rather than earlier pose, selects the startup mode.
Tensor-buffer ownership changes packed input after identical pre-flattening sources.
A hidden runtime-state or PoseSearch boundary outside the instrumented interval selects the mode.
expected_if_hypothesis_correct: The trace is behavior-neutral and an existing sample one fixed tick before Mode A has live-pose deltas in the Mode-B direction and magnitude; velocity publication explains any residual mismatch.
falsification_observation: The trace is behavior-neutral, captures the hypothesized earlier fixed tick, and that earlier sample does not match the Mode-B direction or magnitude.

primary_metrics: exact first-policy and active-standing input hashes
exact semantic, provenance, physics, policy, and render hashes
chronology ordering, finiteness, body counts, runtime state, world time, accumulator, and policy tick
published body position, rotation, linear velocity, and angular velocity

orientation.graphify_result: The graph located TickComponent, TickRuntimeStateMachine, TickPolicyAndUpdateMetrics, and their surrounding runtime path.
orientation.serena_result: TickComponent calls the runtime-state machine before policy update; GatherCurrentBodySamples is a read-only live transform/velocity observer and does not query PoseSearch, raycast terrain, run inference, or dispatch controls.

implementation.trace_behavior: When the explicit development flag and RealOnnxPolicy variant are active, read existing owner, mesh, root-bone, live body, state, accumulator, and policy-tick values before the runtime-state update, after it, and after policy update. Stop after the first policy tick or twelve samples.
implementation.publication: A separate startup-chronology.json development artifact is written only when the explicit flag is enabled; it is absent from the production manifest and activation contract.

tdd.red_cpp_contract: Compilation failed because the chronology types, validator, publication, and component flag seam did not exist.
tdd.red_runner_contract: The script contract failed because build.ps1 did not yet forward the explicit chronology flag.

baseline.configuration: Locked RealOnnxPolicy standing-plant v2 configuration; 1/60 s fixed step; 10 s; unchanged seed and initial pose; no perturbation; action and provenance traces on; startup chronology trace off.

experimental.configuration: Identical binary, model, protocol, seed, pose, fixed step, capture window, evaluator, action trace, and provenance trace; only startup chronology tracing changed from off to on.
experimental.key_metrics: Byte-identical physics and policy streams make all baseline key metrics identical.

comparison.chronology_observation: The BridgeActive-to-Standing_Preparation state transition and first policy update did not change the live owner, mesh, root, body pose, or zero velocities within the 0.033333335-second tick. Every chronology sample exactly equals the Mode-A first-input Manny source.
comparison.coverage_gap: The hypothesized previous fixed tick was not observed. TickComponent returns from the WaitingForPoseSearch branch before the current chronology hooks, so the trace begins only on the first-inference tick.

conclusion.summary: The observation trace is behavior-neutral and proves that the same-tick BridgeActive-to-Standing_Preparation transition does not create Mode B. It does not observe the prior fixed tick required to test the registered earlier-sample hypothesis, so that hypothesis cannot honestly be supported or falsified from E8.
conclusion.what_was_learned: Mode A's first input uses a zero-velocity live body sample that is unchanged before the runtime-state update, after it, and after inference on the same tick. The next information boundary is the WaitingForPoseSearch early-return tick, not more physics tuning or a policy delay.

next_highest_information_experiment.name: Pre-return WaitingForPoseSearch chronology coverage
next_highest_information_experiment.hypothesis: The fixed tick immediately before Mode A, currently hidden behind the WaitingForPoseSearch early return, contains the live body state in the Mode-B direction; its velocity publication differs from Mode A's all-zero source.
next_highest_information_experiment.single_variable: Observation coverage only: extend the existing explicit development trace across the WaitingForPoseSearch branch without changing PoseSearch calls, inference timing, physics, or dispatch.
next_highest_information_experiment.expected_if_correct: A 0.0166667-second sample appears before the existing 0.0333333-second Mode-A source, and its body pose delta is opposite the known delay-plus-one delta with comparable magnitude; velocity publication identifies any residual.
next_highest_information_experiment.falsifier: The prior fixed tick is captured validly and is identical to Mode A or points away from the Mode-B direction.
next_highest_information_experiment.locked_metrics: The same exact A/B hashes, evaluator failures, readback ratio, stage ordering/finiteness/body counts, plus per-body signed position/rotation/velocity deltas against Mode A and E7 delay-plus-one.
